==Concepts==
*lujvo - a verb formally consisting of rafsi according to Lojban morphology.
*jvajvo - a lujvo that can be unwrapped into a bridi according to rules of its consisting slotted rafsi.
*cimjvo - a lujvo the meaning (+ sometimes place structure) of which is unpredictable from its constituent rafsi
* turjvo - a lujvo that has rafsi taking certain positions (slots) in the lujvo with fixed effect.
==turjvo classes==
If for a given lujvo you find more places than listed here it means this lujvo is not a jvajvo.

# '''-gau''' suffix. '''x1 x2 x3 x4 ... brodygau''' unwraps into '''x1 gasnu lo nu x2 broda x3 x4 ...'''. Equivalent to '''x1 jai gau broda fai x2 x3 x4 ...'''
# '''-ske''' suffix. '''brodyske''' = ''x1 is the broda science, broda-ology studying particular subject x2''
# '''-pre''' suffix. '''brodypre''' means ''x1 is a brodaman, a broda-er''. Roughly corresponds to English "-er" or "-man" like "fireman" etc. Can describe only persons, not non-conscious pbjects.
# '''cmacma''', '''brabra''' mean ''very small'', ''very big''. Unwrap according to [[la tsani|La Tsani]]'s Flipping Principle.
# '''bra-''' prefix generates cimjvo. '''brabroda''' - ''something like broda metaphorically''. The place structure is identical to '''broda'''. '''bramlatu''' is ''Big Cat'', not ''big cat''. '''braxamsi''' is described by some not just as a ''big xamsi'' but having some new properties.
#* Not sure if it's truly a cimjvo. It seems like '''brabroda''' is more like '''ce'u broda ce'u li'o gi'e barda gi'e co'e''', with '''co'e''' being defined by whatever semantic needs that drive one to use '''brabroda''' over '''barda (je) broda''' or '''ze'u broda'''.
#**the examples with '''bramlatu''' and '''braxamsi''' show that the meaning can't be clearly predicted. [[User:Gleki|La Gleki]] ([[User talk:Gleki|talk]]) 23:44, 31 djulio 2015 (PDT)
# '''cma-''' prefix generates cimjvo.
# '''tce-''' prefix. '''tcebroda''' unwraps into '''mutce lo ka ce'u broda'''
# '''zan-''' prefix is applied to the whole lujvo part after it, doesn't need '''kem''' after it. Marks the tail as something favorable, nice, cool.
# '''mal-''' prefix is applied to the whole lujvo part after it, doesn't need '''kem''' after it. Marks the tail as something bad, deplorable, shitty.
==lo seltau that are adverbial==
* certain prefixes work as adverbs. i.e. in a lujvo with two {{jvs|selbrisle}} they dont take the position of x2 of the tertau.
** Example: '''tce-''' prefix. In '''tcebroda''' in instead puts '''broda''' into x2 of '''mutce''' in expansion.
** See also [[selskiski].
